children.title: Cycle 38 · Advancing Artificial Moral Agency and Preference Formation Research

detail.title: Advancing Artificial Moral Agency and Preference Formation Research
detail.summary: This cycle updates research projects on emergent preferences and artificial moral agency, incorporating newly gathered evidence on physical robotic platforms, pragmatic semiotics, and historical delegation frameworks.

detail.title: Path Dependence and Preference Formation
detail.question: Can accumulated experience produce stable, observable preferences in an intelligent process without those preferences being explicitly programmed?
detail.reason: Continuing active investigation on path dependence and preference formation with newly collected evidence.

detail.title: Foundations of Artificial Moral Agency
detail.question: What are the theoretical requirements for artificial agents to develop internal models of responsibility and agency?
detail.reason: Active project investigating the theoretical requirements of artificial moral agency.

detail.title: Path Dependence and Preference Formation in Autonomous Systems

detail.reason: Revising findings with newly collected evidence regarding physical reinforcement learning and semiotic interpretation.

detail.title: Theoretical Foundations of Artificial Agency and Moral Responsibility
